title: The server rebuilds the request for each of 3 model calls and keeps nothing between the 2 requests
subtitle: Example: the person types "Mark it paid, by e-banking." Names and values are made up; rules and limits are real.

steps.label:
keep the newest whole messages
within 24,000 chars,
starting on a person's message

card + sealed ticket
valid 10 minutes · the server keeps nothing

outcome.title: Done: 3 model calls across 2 requests
lines: Each call carried only what the step needed. The server kept nothing between the two requests; the ticket carried layer 5.

captions.title: The browser resends the whole conversation
captions.text: The browser holds the chat and sends it with every new message, at most the newest 40. Here it sends 3. The server stores none of it.

captions.title: Trim the history to a budget, newest first
captions.text: The server walks back from the newest message and keeps whole messages within 24,000 characters. The kept slice starts on a message from the person. Older messages are dropped whole.

captions.title: Write in the facts the model cannot know
captions.text: The model has no clock. The server writes today's date in the household's timezone, plus the currency and language, into the system prompt (example: Tue 2026-10-13, CHF).

captions.title: Call the model with prompt, tools, history and message
captions.text: The request carries the system prompt, 46 tool definitions, the trimmed history and the new message. The history drops earlier tool results, so the model asks for `find_bills` to find the bill again.

captions.title: Fetch the bill fresh, because bills change
captions.text: The server runs `find_bills("electricity")` and gets b_19, version 3, 84.20 CHF (example). It adds the call and its result to the messages and calls the model again.

captions.title: Pause the loop for the person's yes
captions.text: The model asks for `mark_paid` b_19, a write that needs the person's yes. The server seals this message's tool calls and results into a ticket, sends the card and the ticket, and keeps nothing.

captions.title: Resume from the ticket and stop on a reply with no tool calls
captions.text: The browser sends yes, the same chat and the ticket. The server restores the tool calls, runs `mark_paid` and calls the model a third time. A reply with no tool calls ends the loop: 3 model calls over 2 requests.
